legend: Endoscopy shows macroscopic findings of duodenal-type follicular lymphoma with numerous whitish granules.

Duodenal biopsy at low magnification showing enlarged villi infiltrated by lymphoma forming a glove-balloon sign (<<30435>>). The infiltrate is composed of abnormal lymphoid follicles (<<31788>>). The follicles comprise mostly small lymphoid cells (centrocytes), with no admixed tingible-body macrophages (<<31783>>). The lamina propria also shows infiltration by a monotonous population of small lymphoid cells (<<31784>>).

Duodenal biopsy showing abnormal lymphoid follicles as well as lamina propria infiltration by lymphoid cells (<<31782>>). Immunostaining for CD20 highlights the follicles as well as the lymphoid cells in the lamina propria (<<31785>>). A similar pattern is seen for CD10, indicating that the extrafollicular lymphoid cells show germinal centre cell differentiation (<<31786>>). The follicles show strong immunostaining for BCL2, and the extrafollicular lymphoid cells are also strongly positive (<<31787>>).
